subject: Discovery wrap / POC commitment & kickoff plan — Quantive
messages:
From: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.com>
To: Claire O'Neill <claire@quantive.ai>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-20T16:08:00-07:00
Subject: Quick recap + proposed POC scope (follow-up)

Claire — thanks again for 30 minutes earlier. Wanted to capture what we heard, confirm priority success metrics, and surface the minimal access/owners to get a 6-week POC moving. Please flag anything I mis-stated.

Summary of what you shared (pain & goals)
- Pain: High false positives in rule-based QA routing causing customer support load + slow triage (average 18–24 hrs).
- Goal: Reduce manual triage time by surfacing a shortlist of likely categories and suggested responses so agents can act within 1–2 hrs.
- Constraints: PHI redaction required for transcripts; data cannot leave US region.

Proposed POC scope (minimal, timeboxed)
- Duration: 6 weeks (2-week ingest & baseline, 3-week iterative tuning, 1-week eval + handoff)
- Inputs: 10k anonymized transcripts (sample set), current routing rules, agent response templates
- Deliverables: baseline accuracy/recall on category detection, prompt set for suggested responses, deployment runbook for Redwood Private (VPC) or Dedicated depending on procurement outcome

Success metrics (initial)
- Category recall >= 80% on holdout set
- Suggested-response acceptance rate >= 45% (agent accepts suggestion)
- Median end-to-end suggestion latency <= 300ms (under target traffic shape)

Owners / roles
- Redwood: Lukas (Eng lead, POC config & observability), Grace (Prompt engineering & evals), Marcus (Security checklist & infra)
- Quantive: Claire (product sponsor), suggested engineering contact (TBD), procurement for contracts/commits

Immediate asks / next steps
1) Confirm the 6-week scope and success metrics (reply ok / edits)
2) Share 2-3 sample transcripts (anonymized) or grant S3 read-only link to a staging bucket (we can take a scrub step if you prefer)
3) Provide a procurement contact so we can share a one-page POC order and estimate for Dedicated capacity (if you want Reserved capacity)
4) We’ll share a one-page POC charter + access checklist by EOD tomorrow — attachment: redwood-poc-charter-quantive-v1.pdf

Attachments: redwood-poc-charter-quantive-v1.pdf (POC charter draft)

If this looks right I’ll: finalize the charter, schedule a 30-min kickoff for next week, and send a short Data Access form (CSV) for your engineering team.

Thanks,
Lukas Meyer
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
l.meyer@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0182
From: Claire O'Neill <claire@quantive.ai>
To: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@quantive.ai>
Date: 2026-05-21T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick recap + proposed POC scope (follow-up)

Thanks Lukas — this is a great summary and aligns with what we discussed. A couple of clarifications and asks from our side: 

- Timeline: the 6-week window is fine but we need the ingest/baseline to be faster if possible (can we compress to 10 business days for the first phase?)
- Data: we can provide 12k anonymized transcripts from May–June (staging S3). I’ll ask Engineering for a read-only IAM role — they prefer to push credentials rather than share links.
- PHI redaction: we must ensure redaction occurs before any data leaves our environment — can Redwood run the redaction step inside our VPC or do you need the scrubbed material delivered?

Looping in Procurement for the POC order and committed capacity discussion.

Date: 2026-05-21T17:30:00-07:00
Subject: POC kickoff proposal + access checklist (actionable)

Claire — thanks for the quick confirmation and for looping Procurement. Per your asks, two quick updates and an actionable checklist so procurement/engineering can move forward.

Compressed timeline: we can compress Phase 1 (ingest & baseline) into 10 business days if Quantive can provide the anonymized S3 read-only role by EOD Wednesday.

PHI redaction options (pick one)
- Option A (preferred for speed): You grant read-only access to a staging bucket inside your VPC; Redwood will deploy a redaction lambda in your account to redact PHI and write sanitized objects to a separate staging path. No raw data leaves your account.
- Option B: You deliver transcripts already scrubbed; Redwood ingests sanitized files into our Private environment for the POC.

POC kickoff proposed dates
- Kickoff (30 min): Tue 2026-05-25 09:00 PDT — platform orientation, owners, access checklist review
- Baseline ingest start: Wed 2026-05-26
- Weekly syncs: Tuesdays 30 min (standup + blockers)

Prompt set & eval plan (brief)
- Grace will prepare an initial prompt matrix (10 candidate prompts) and a lightweight eval harness that computes recall/precision and suggestion-acceptance tracking against holdout transcripts.
- We’ll run three prompt tuning cycles by week 4 and publish a short report with examples.

Action items for Quantive (needed to start)
1) Provide S3 read-only IAM role OR deliver sanitized files (CSV/JSON) — see attached: quantive-access-requests.csv
2) Confirm kickoff time (reply with ok / propose)
3) Procurement: please confirm order contact and whether Reserved Dedicated capacity estimate is required for legal review

Attachments: redwood-poc-charter-quantive-v1.pdf, quantive-access-requests.csv

Links: POC folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B-Quantive-POC
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/quantive/QNTV-2026-0423

If that works I’ll send a calendar invite and a short DocuSign for the POC order (one page).

Best,
Lukas Meyer
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
